summary: Tested FaZes/Horário Trabalho end-to-end via the public preview URL. Backend: created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) covering health, upload validation, unknown-job 404 and the full async OCR job flow with the real image PDF — 6/6 passed (Gemini vision job finished in ~35s, month=9, year=2026, 7 employees, 30/30 filled days each). Frontend (Playwright): real PDF upload showed the 'PDF em modo imagem — a extrair via OCR no servidor…' notice, then 'Quem és tu?' modal, then the Setembro 2026 calendar with 7 employees/codes (M50, IT2, D, M7, M26, M16, T6); Histórico drawer listed the entry ('Setembro 2026 · 7 pessoas' + 'Atual' badge); month navigation showed/hid month-mismatch-warning correctly; history load closes the drawer and loads the schedule; history delete removes the entry from UI + localStorage; page reload kept schedule and history (fazes:history:v1); offline badge appeared with context.set_offline(True) and the offline image-PDF upload produced the clear Portuguese error about needing internet for OCR (no crash), badge disappeared back online. Auto-load on month navigation was additionally verified with a seeded 2-month history (prev-month switched to the saved Agosto 2026 schedule with no warning). No console/runtime errors observed.

design_issues.screen: Calendar with month mismatch (e.g. Outubro 2026 while Setembro is loaded)
issues: Besides the warning banner, the grid and the 'RESUMO DE OUTUBRO · 30 DIAS COM CÓDIGO' summary are still filled with the other month's codes, which can be misread as real data; day 31 renders an empty cell with a stray '·'. Consider dimming/blanking the grid or labelling it 'dados de Setembro'.

action_items: Optional (testability): data-testid="drawer-close" is duplicated on all four always-mounted drawers (pessoas/horarios/trocas/relogio/historico). Off-screen drawers are still in the DOM and intercept pointer events, which makes automation clicks resolve to hidden elements. Suggest per-drawer testids (e.g. drawer-close-historico) and/or pointer-events:none + inert when closed.
Optional (UX): consider muting the calendar/summary when the visible month does not match the loaded schedule (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 890 lines — consider splitting drawers/modals into separate components (already partially done with MonthCalendar/CodesDrawer).

Backend job store (_JOBS) is in-memory; a backend restart/hot-reload during a 30-60s OCR loses the job and the frontend polls until timeout. Acceptable for the current single-pod preview, but note it for production/multi-replica.
history entries store the entire schedule per month in localStorage (capped at 24). saveJSON swallows quota errors silently — a user hitting quota gets no feedback; consider surfacing a warning.
seed_data_creation: For the month-auto-load check, two synthetic schedules (SEED_9_2026.pdf / SEED_8_2026.pdf) were injected into localStorage in a throwaway browser context only; no server-side data created. Real PDF /app/test_files/HORARIO_TTAES_PLACA_SETEMBRO_2026.pdf used for the OCR flows (2 online OCR runs total).
test_credentials: N/A - app has no auth (/app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but is not needed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: browser_automation_tool starts a fresh browser context each run, so localStorage does NOT persist between tool calls — do the whole flow in one script, or seed localStorage (fazes:schedule:v1, fazes:history:v1) via page.evaluate to avoid paying 35-60s per OCR upload. When seeding a schedule, the 'Quem és tu?' me-modal appears on reload and blocks all clicks: dismiss it with [data-testid="me-pick-1"]. Always scope drawer-close clicks (use .last on '[data-testid="history-drawer"] [data-testid="drawer-close"]') because 4 drawers share that testid. History item testids include the title, e.g. history-load-2026-9-HORARIO_TTAES_PLACA_SETEMBRO_2026.pdf; prefer prefix selectors [data-testid^="history-load-"]. Backend regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (runs in ~35s, xdist configured in pytest.ini).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found in the new features (history, month navigation + auto-load, mismatch warning, offline badge/error). Earlier test-run failures were purely selector/environment artefacts: duplicated drawer-close testids on hidden always-mounted drawers, and the fresh browser context wiping localStorage between tool calls.
